@AustralianArmy soldiers from Battlegroup Ram, teamed up with @YourPhilArmy for a Combined Arms Live Fire Exercise.

The combined integrated fire teams conducted the activity as a part of Exercise Alon 2025, at 📍 Fort Magsaysay, Philippines.

This was the culmination of weeks of integration training between 🇦🇺 and 🇵🇭, which showcased:
💥 M777 Howitzers
💥 81mm F2 Mortars
💥 Australian Light Armoured Vehicles (ASLAVs)
